summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py, placed after print. It joins objects via str() with sep and makes one print call with emoji=False, markup=False, no_wrap=True, overflow="ignore", crop=False, plus the given style, highlight (default True), and end. Added tests in tests/test_console.py (test_out and test_out_* variants, plus a render hook test) with RenderHook and Text imports at the top. Added "Added Console.out" to CHANGELOG.md under Unreleased. Added a "Low level output" section to docs/source/console.rst after logging. Nothing was committed and tests were not run, per instructions; verification was by reading only.
